about: Budgets of the fast mode of spinal_bisect.ts (spinal_bisect_check.ts in test.sh, core issue 450): variants of the Spinal Tap page on the native engine with no window, 40 ticks of 16 ms. Paths are into the run's JSON (variants.NAME.engine...). Rules of spinal_budgets.mjs: a budget fails when missed; a known failure is printed while it fails and fails the check when met (move it to the budgets); the file may only tighten (ratchet against the merge base). Times have about three times the measurement as margin; frame counters are exact.

native.measured: 2026-11-15, Apple M1, engine wip/prim-reuse ac8688851 (macOS branch build 43736471631), after PR 460; spinal_bisect_check.ts 40 ticks

variants.static.engine.tick.layouts.what: the page's DOM with no scripts: 40 ticks lay out nothing (a page that does not change pays no layout)

variants.static.engine.second_layouts.what: a second frame of the unchanged page keeps its layout

variants.empty.engine.tick.median.what: a tick of an empty page

variants.static.engine.first_ms.what: first layered frame of the page's DOM (layout and compile)

variants.static.engine.tick.median.what: a tick of the unchanged page (no layout, no recompile): 11.5 before PR 460, 3.4 after

variants.static.engine.probe_ms.what: a whole-page frame with the CPU probe
variants.static.engine.probe_ms.accepted: macOS CI runner (build.yml 43749125655): 560 ms, with full 574 and no-zoom 559; the same frame in spinal_perf (probe.first_ms) is about 500 ms on an M1 with its budget at 1500. Known slow, issue 450: the probe's SVG text work; the limit matches spinal-perf's until that is fixed

variants.no-svg.engine.probe_ms.what: the same with no inline SVG: the probe cost is the SVG text (glyph outlines)

variants.plus-timer.engine.tick.recompil.what: a 16 ms timer changing one digit: 40 ticks lay the page out again and compile only the changed glyph (structural reuse, WebPaint.samePrimitive; 113,840 = 2846 a tick before)

variants.plus-timer.engine.tick.median.what: a tick of the timer page: 48.2 before structural reuse

variants.plus-timer.engine.tick.median.issue: issue 450: a one-digit text change still lays out the whole page each tick (relayout of the changed subtree only is not done)

window.measured: 2026-11-15, Apple M1, release engine cc73af028, off-screen window, idle_loop_check.ts (4 s after the first frame of an empty page)

window.empty.idle.turnsPerSecond.what: loop wakeups per second of an idle window over 4 s (the first 200 ms of quiet still poll): it waits in the window library up to 100 ms; 10.8 over 14 s; 92 with the old 8 ms poll

window.empty.idle.waits.what: the idle loop waits in the window library (a window library with no wait fails this)

window.empty.idle.eventsAfterWait.what: no native event comes to an idle off-screen window, so every wait ran to its deadline

pipeline.measured: 2026-11-16, Apple M1, release engine 1b2fc90d5, off-screen window, pipeline_trace_check.ts (Spinal Tap watched for 10 s); frame p95 34 to 41 ms and blocked 285 to 330 ms over 8 runs of 20 s

pipeline.spinal.costlessSubmits.what: GPU submissions of the watch with no cost given to the gate: a band or a partial draw without its cost is slept through for the whole frame's GPU time before its ask (frames of 500 to 870 ms on 2026-11-16)

pipeline.spinal.submits.what: the watch drew: the count above is over real submissions

pipeline.spinal.frameMsP95.what: frame time (request to present) p95 of the watch; the ceiling is the p95 before the gate was driven by the loop (313 ms, engine 04740693f), not a target: about eight times the measurement

pipeline.spinal.gpuBlockedMs.what: main thread blocked inside GPU waits over the 10 s watch; asks that start before the GPU is done (the gate before 2026-11-16) block 4,300 to 5,000 ms in 20 s
